column3: Launch Visual Studio; create a C# Console App (selecting the last target framework); open the .csproj editor and add a NuGet ItemGroup (NuGet.Commands 4.0.0 + NuGet.Packaging 3.5.0), save and build; add <WarningsAsErrors></WarningsAsErrors>, save and build (NU1605 promoted to an error); then add NoWarn="NU1605" to the NuGet.Packaging reference, save and build again. No assertions: the run drives the UI and captures a screenshot at each phase. The template pick, framework 'last item' selection, and all .csproj editor edits are keyboard/clipboard driven against the UIA-opaque VS editor and are flagged LIVE-TUNE where VS version / UI language may shift them.
